notes.title: Confirmed! The Early Access release date is October 20
notes.notes:
Dear Stonkers



We have a confirmed date for our Early Access release!

🕒 October 20 at 09:00AM Pacific time 🕒



Confirmed. Double confirmed. Triple Confirmed.

Save the date, and please Wishlist the game so you get notified as soon as it is released!


💰Pricing
Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue will release in Early Access at $10.99, with a 15% launch discount for a limited time to jump in from day one!
Note: Version 1.0 will be slightly pricier.
[p align="start"]launch price:
[p align="start"]💵 USD – $10.99 💵

🧮 Launch Discount - 15% 🧮


💞A massive Thank You to our Community!
You waited... and waited... and waited. We cannot be more grateful for your patience, your support, and your encouragement.

The recent phase had some uncertainty to say the least, and that is over. The date is definitive, and all clearances are obtained.

We as developers are finally getting rid of the anxiety of waiting for release and entering the excitement phase of polishing the game up to your expectations for the 1.0 Full Release.


🔥What to expect during Early Access
We are moving forward with the roadmap announced on the Steam page, with the guidance and feedback of our dear Stonkers and hand in hand with them.

You may felt hints that we'd been working on it since the start of the waiting phase, and indeed we have already completed quite a few milestones of the roadmap:

📦 Stockers: Done ✅

🔨 Bouncers: Done ✅

📈 Trade Ins: Internal Testing

🎨 New Skins and Wallpapers: Done ✅

🏦 Upgradable Bank: Done ✅

🦸 NPC diversity: Done ✅

🎭 NPC Behavior diversity: In development

🏏 Weapons: Internal Testing

🧳 NPC Loot: Internal Testing

💬 Dialogues: Done ✅


🏞 The roadmap is not everything!
There is more. The roadmap is a promise, and we are keeping that promise. However, from time to time, there are inputs and feedback from the community that is of much higher value than the roadmap items. Do we drop them? Definitely not, we prioritize them.

🔧 Perma Upgrades and Additional 🃏 Mod Packs are such cases.

We strongly encourage you all (in fact, we beg you) to keep up the suggestions and feedback so we make the best game we can and meet your expectations.

🔊You can do so as posts on Steam's community hub or the corresponding channels on our Discord server.


👥What is next for the Community
More of them same! We are reinvigorating our Guild of Experts and as usual observing the channels dedicated to your feedback, both on Steam and Discord 👾.

Meanwhile we are preparing some events:

🎆 Steam Next Fest event coming up

🚀 Launch event coming up

Thank you in advance for playing the game, and we are waiting for your guidance!



See you on the other side of Early Access

Your GameStonk Simulator: Gone Rogue team

notes.title: EA Release date and details!
notes.notes:
Hey last physical videogame store saviours!

GameStonk Simulator is finally coming to Steam Early Access July 30 at 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT!

💰 Pricing
Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue will launch in Early Access at $10.99, with a 15% launch discount for a limited time to jump in from day one!
Note: Version 1.0 will be slightly pricier.

launch price:  

💵 USD – $10.99


❤️ A Huge Thank You to Our Community
We wouldn’t be here without you. Your feedback on our demo, bug reports, suggestions, and support have shaped Gamestonk Simulator at every step.

Early Access is our next big leap with you, letting us keep refining, expanding, and polishing with your ideas in mind. Let’s keep building the ultimate shop simulator together!

🔥 What to Expect in Early Access
🛒 Fully playable core roguelite shop loop  

📦 Endless Mode for chill tycoon fans  

🎮 Retro collection that persists across runs  

🃏 Strategic modifiers each morning  

🧍‍♂️ Staff you can hire (cashiers)  

🪓 Defend your store from shoplifters with your trusty bat  

🗺️ Expanding store upgrades


And that’s just the start. Our Early Access roadmap includes:  

🟠 New employee roles  

🟠 NPC behavior improvements  

🟠 Expanded trade-in systems  

🟠 More skins, wallpapers, and decor  

🟠 Deeper bank mechanics  

🟠 Weapons and loot improvements  

🟠 NPC dialogues

🎯 About the Demo
Our Demo will remain live on Steam even after Early Access launches. If you haven’t tried it yet, you can still check it out for free and remember to leave a review once you do. The Early Access version is a big step forward in content and polish, but we’re keeping the demo up so new players can get a taste first.


💚 Wishlist & Stay Connected
🗓️ Mark your calendars for July 30!  


👉 Please wishlist Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue on Steam, it helps us massively and ensures you’re notified as soon as we go live.


We can’t wait to see the chaos you’ll unleash managing the last game store in town. Thanks for all your support, and see you in Early Access!


❤️The GameStonk Simulator: Gone Rogue Team. ❤️

notes.title: The Demo Update Everyone's Been Waiting For!
notes.notes:
Additions:

 Collectibles: Unlocks on day 4, you get to buy some Bags that "fell off the back of a truck" from a certain bunch you'd mother wouldn't want you to hang out with. The thing is, each bag contains 3 mystery Retros that could range in rarity from: Common, Gold, Holographic, Galactic. Access your collection with TAB. You can purchase Retro displays for your collection from the Van to both show off your Retros and even make some serious buck out of them. Careful though, nothing is safe from those customers with sticky hands.
 Added a button to copy the music credits from the game settings
 Added a toggle option to turn on/off the control hints in the game settings
 Added tutorial posters and removed shelf tutorial
 Added (work in progress) language support for: French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean


Updates:

 You can put boxed up shelves in storage
 Storage room door is now open by default
 Updated spawn rate, collectables, market items and modifier data


Fixes:

 Fixed audio settings not savings
 Fixed customers getting stuck on shelves
 Fixed an exploit where you can get a free re-roll by reloading the game after purchasing all the van items
 Fixed items on shelves moving up after load
 Fixed storage cabinet load and save issue (items falling off boxes, boxes falling off)
 Fixed reloading on hot release day causing customers to start spawning again even after end of day
 Fixed customers walking through checkout counter
 Fixed cart MOQ text showing when it should not
 Fixed bat disappearing under the ground after placing the counter on top of it
 Fixed customers looking at nothing after moving their target shelf
 Fixed able to choose negative numbers in ordering interface
 Fixed supply cuts on day 1


Big note: you will lose your saves in this version, so if you have a shop at day 100, prepare to say your final goodbyes.

notes.title: Update #1 to the Guild of Experts
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321263/35d8b47192a35bc655a24fbede8fcac101456867.png

Hey Stonkers

We initially tried tracking points and ranks as mentioned in the Stonky Rewards Program we explained above, but things got complicated fast. Since many of you were excited about the Rewards Program, we’re keeping its spirit alive—just in a simpler, more streamlined way!

What’s Changing?
No more ranks or point counting.
Instead, our dev team will review community contributions twice a month, focusing on:
Streams, VODs, YouTube videos, TikToks—any content about GameStonk Simulator (quality, length, and engagement matter).
Valuable feedback shared on our Discord.

From there, we’ll select contributors to join our exclusive Guild of Experts Channel, where they'll get:
✅ Access to dev builds to test new features before it's released to the general public and provide direct feedback.
✅ The chance to have your actual voice recorded and included as in-game audio.
✅ And more surprises brewing…

How to Join the Guild of Experts
1️⃣ Create high-quality content about GameStonk Simulator and share it in ⁠📽clips-and-highlights .
2️⃣ Provide helpful and unique feedback in ⁠🪲bugs-n-feedback .

We'll review contributions semi-monthly and invite select members to join.

🚀 Excited to join the Guild of Experts? React to this message to let us know!

And if you have any questions, drop it in the ⁠💬ᴍᴀɪɴ-ᴄʜᴀᴛ and I'll get back to you!

Happy game selling/people smacking!

notes.title: A new version is out!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the massive feedback you've provided over the past couple of weeks, we've been hard at work and we're very excited for you to try this version. As always join our discord and report any bugs or feedback there for quicker communication.

Additions:

 Added rotation and movement effects to the customers loot drops
 Added new banknotes art and coins textures
 Added resolution and Fullscreen options to settings. Note that I'm forcing resolutions with 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios. Ultrawide aspect resolutions (21:9) are causing many UI issues so we opted to exclude their support for now.
 Added "Riot" days to the calendar where customers are more likely to steal on those days
 Added furniture releases notices to calendar
 Added Credits to main menu
 Added a roadmap to main menu screen
 Added Settings to main menu
 Added furniture snapping (hold alt)
 Added demo locks


Fixes:

 Fixed reroll cost getting stuck and not resetting the following day
 Fixed sensitivity and audio settings not saving
 Fixed an issue causing box thieves not to detect boxes, you should start encountering them now. Assuming you leave boxes on the ground (not on storage shelves)
 Fixed a bunch of typos (please let us know if you find any others)
 Fixed compatibility bonus modifier text
 Loan and rent bill now take into account when you took out the loan/expanded the store (updated daily, instead of weekly)
 Fixed customers stuck after moving the checkout desk
 Fixed checkout items stacking weirdly when checkout location is changed
 Fixed blue controller UI image
 Fixed storage cabinet disappearing after coming back to a save
 Fixed being able to place boxes over each other in storage cabinet which resulted in one of the boxes disappearing
 Fixed bat disappearing when checkout counter moved over it.
 Fixed incorrect item price calculation (some items were being sold at a loss)
 Fixed mugging and checkout counter not incrementing correctly
 Fixed total value calculation in daily report missed orders, revenue and expenses drop-downs
 Fixed box thieves stealing boxes from your hand


Updates:

 Replaced placeholder van item models
 Updated calendar UI
 Updated van UI
 Updated cart UI
 Removed repeat items from the van (note that on the first day repeat items might still show up if you already bought the license, since the total possible items will be less than 3)
 Trash bin will show up on day 1 in the van
 Thieves will no longer show up before day 3
 Lowered customer SFX utterance rate to %25 and made them less noisy (if they are still too much, please let us know)
 Removed currency localization: We believe this was causing the issue of item prices being extremely long. Currencies will now all be evaluated as US dollars
 The mouse is no longer confined to the window when the UI is open
